bias.en: Bearish · back above the Oct 15 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 10月15日低点上方

read.en: Corning rose 2.0% on Oct 21 to $134.92, trading between $133.22 and $136.72. It is above the falling 5-day average ($134.1) but below the falling 10-day ($141.7), 30-day ($151.3) and 100-day ($165.5) and the rising 200-day ($154.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($153.32), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 康宁 10月21日上涨 2.0%，收于 $134.92，盘中区间 $133.22–136.72。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$134.1）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$141.7）、30 日（$151.3）和 100 日均线（$165.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$154.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$153.32），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $132.75 Oct 15 low and the 5-day average, and the low stayed above both. Resistance is $136.7 (day's high), then $137.4–138.7 (Oct 15–19 highs) and $141.6 (10-day, Aug 24 low). Support is $134.1 (5-day), then $132.75 and $127.6 (Oct 20 low). A close above $138.7 would target $141.6; a close below $132.75 would reopen $127.6.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $132.75 的 10月15日低点及 5 日均线，盘中低点也守在二者之上。阻力为 $136.7（当日高点），其次 $137.4–138.7（10月15日至19日高点）和 $141.6（10 日均线、8月24日低点）。支撑为 $134.1（5 日均线），其次 $132.75 和 $127.6（10月20日低点）。若收盘站上 $138.7，下一目标看 $141.6；若收盘跌破 $132.75，将重新打开 $127.6。
